verdict.rationale: Supabase evidence shows self-hosting can give 'full control over your data' (supabase-docs-3/29), which implicitly lets a user manage retention/deletion themselves, but there is no explicit documentation of retention policies, data-deletion APIs, project/account deletion, or GDPR-style erasure tooling in the pack. missing for 10: explicit data retention settings, documented deletion/erasure APIs or dashboard controls, and any first-party statement on backup retention or data lifecycle policies.
